note: M5 session 8, planned 2026-10-18 before the run: M5 re-judged on the world model kept per visit, which every reader has used since 2026-10-17 (docs/plans/autonomous-curiosity.md, milestone M5). Version 4 was developed on the shakedown and sessions 1-6 and tested on session 7, so this is the first staged session it has not seen, filed live on the rover rather than on the desk, and the first in which an autonomous run plans around its records. Two bean bags only. The red one is moved to the table's corridor end, where the black one ended session 7 yesterday: a look-alike put down where the other stood the day before, the case that failed version 2 in session 5. Order as in session 7, except that the owner sets the two out with the rover on its charger, not switched off (session 7's cold boot cost it a settled map): the coding agent runs session_preflight.py, the owner unplugs it, loop A from the charger, living room first; session_check.py runs once loop A's "viewpoint": "living-4" note is written and the move list is given while the rover drives the corridor; a bean bag with fewer than two pictures in loop A is not moved. The wait at bedroom-2 ends when the owner says the moves are done. Then loop B, a 3.5-minute run from where loop B ends, home (session.py all session8-1018 --b-first). Places are map coordinates; where things really stood and went is read afterwards from the scans and photographs into session8-1018.json.
